privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Our privacy policy governs how we collect, store, and use visitor data.
privacy.content: At Smart Calculators Hub, we prioritize visitor privacy. All calculation operations are executed client-side whenever possible, and we do not store your private calculation parameters on our servers. We use standard cookie mechanisms for user preferences (such as language selection) and integrations such as Google Analytics to track general usage statistics. If we display ads through Google AdSense, third-party cookies may be used to serve personalized ads based on your web activity. You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting your browser settings.

bmi.title: BMI Calculator
bmi.description: Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) to determine if your weight is healthy for your height
bmi.howItWorks: BMI is calculated by dividing weight in kilograms by height in meters squared.
bmi.exampleText: For a person weighing 70 kg and 170 cm tall: BMI = 70 / (1.70)² = 24.22 (Normal weight)

loan.title: Loan Calculator
loan.description: Calculate your monthly loan payment, total interest, and total amount payable
loan.howItWorks: Use this loan calculator to compute monthly payments and build an amortization schedule. Helps evaluate mortgage, auto, or personal loans.
loan.exampleText: For a loan of $10,000 at a 5% annual interest rate for 36 months, the monthly payment will be $299.71, with a total interest of $789.52.

percentage.title: Percentage Calculator
percentage.description: Calculate percentage values, percentage changes, and ratios
percentage.whatPercentLabel: X is what percent of Y?
percentage.percentChangeLabel: What is the percentage change from X to Y?
percentage.howItWorks: Calculate percentage values, percentage changes, and ratios.

length.title: Length Converter
length.description: Convert between metric and imperial units of length and distance
length.howItWorks: Convert between metric and imperial units of length and distance instantly.
length.formula: 1 inch = 2.54 cm, 1 foot = 30.48 cm, 1 yard = 91.44 cm, 1 mile = 1.609 km
length.exampleText: To convert 5 feet to meters: 5 * 0.3048 = 1.524 meters.

passwordStrength.title: Password Strength Checker
passwordStrength.description: Check password security and robustness against brute force
passwordStrength.howItWorks: Check password security and robustness against brute force using complexity parameters.
passwordStrength.formula: Password Entropy based on character diversity and length
passwordStrength.exampleText: A password like 'p@ss1' is weak. 'P@ssw0rd2026!' is strong.

simpleInterest.title: Simple Interest Calculator
simpleInterest.description: Calculate simple interest values and total interest accrued
simpleInterest.howItWorks: Simple interest is calculated by multiplying the principal amount, interest rate, and time period.
simpleInterest.exampleText: For a principal of $5,000 at a 6.5% interest rate for 5 years, Simple Interest is $1,625.

compoundInterest.title: Compound Interest Calculator
compoundInterest.description: Calculate compound interest with different compounding frequencies
compoundInterest.howItWorks: Compound interest is calculated on the initial principal and the accumulated interest of previous periods.
compoundInterest.exampleText: For $5,000 at 6.5% interest compounded monthly for 5 years, the total balance will be $6,916.38.

dailyCalories.title: Daily Calorie Calculator
dailyCalories.description: Calculate daily calories needs based on BMR and activity level
dailyCalories.howItWorks: BMR represents calories burned at rest. Daily needs are calculated by multiplying BMR by the activity level multiplier.
dailyCalories.exampleText: For a 25-year-old male weighing 70kg and 175cm tall BMR is 1,678 kcal. Sedentary maintenance is 2,014 kcal.

idealWeight.title: Ideal Weight Calculator
idealWeight.description: Find your ideal body weight range based on gender and height
idealWeight.howItWorks: Uses the Devine formula to calculate the ideal weight based on height over 5 feet (152.4 cm).
idealWeight.formula: Male: 50.0 + 2.3 * Over Inches. Female: 45.5 + 2.3 * Over Inches.
idealWeight.exampleText: For a male with 175 cm (68.9 inches): 50.0 + 2.3 * 8.9 = 70.5 kg.

areaCalculator.title: Area Calculator
areaCalculator.description: Calculate the area of a square, rectangle, or circle
areaCalculator.howItWorks: Applies standard geometric area formulas for the selected shape.
areaCalculator.formula: Square: s², Rectangle: l * w, Circle: π * r²
areaCalculator.exampleText: For a rectangle with length 5 and width 8: 5 * 8 = 40.

volumeCalculator.title: Volume Calculator
volumeCalculator.description: Calculate the volume of a cube, cylinder, or sphere
volumeCalculator.howItWorks: Applies standard geometric volume formulas for the selected shape.
volumeCalculator.formula: Cube: s³, Cylinder: π * r² * h, Sphere: (4/3) * π * r³
volumeCalculator.exampleText: For a cylinder with radius 5 and height 10: π * 5² * 10 = 785.4.

weightConverter.title: Weight Converter
weightConverter.description: Convert weight values between metric and imperial units
weightConverter.howItWorks: Converts input to kilograms first, then scales to the target unit.
weightConverter.exampleText: To convert 10 lbs to kg: 10 * 0.45359 = 4.5359 kg.

temperatureConverter.title: Temperature Converter
temperatureConverter.description: Convert temperatures between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin
temperatureConverter.howItWorks: Converts input to Celsius first, then converts Celsius to the target scale.

downloadSpeed.title: Download Speed & Time Calculator
downloadSpeed.description: Calculate download times for files based on network speed
downloadSpeed.howItWorks: Converts file size to megabits and divides by network transfer speed.
downloadSpeed.formula: Time (sec) = (File Size in GB * 8192) / Speed in Mbps
downloadSpeed.exampleText: For a 5 GB file on a 100 Mbps connection: (5 * 8192) / 100 = 409.6 sec = 6 mins 49 secs.

fileSize.title: File Size Converter
fileSize.description: Convert file size data units between GB, MB, KB, and Bytes
fileSize.howItWorks: Converts input to Bytes first using binary scales (1024), then scales to the target unit.
fileSize.formula: 1 KB = 1024 Bytes, 1 MB = 1024 KB, 1 GB = 1024 MB
fileSize.exampleText: To convert 1 GB to MB: 1 * 1024 = 1024 MB.
